Cost: 3,000eb (Luxury) ♦ Install: Hospital

Humanity Loss: 14 (4d6)

Increases body weight and the power behind melee strikes.

Internal Body Cyberware. Requires 2 Option Slots. After hitting a target with a Brawling, Martial Arts, or Melee Weapon Attack, the victim suffers a -2 penalty to their next Evasion Check made before the start of their next Turn. While installed, the user suffers a -1 penalty to their REF, DEX, and MOVE unless they have BODY 13+ or are a Full Body Conversion, in which case the penalty is negated.

Type: Internal Body Cyberware
Install: Hospital
Option Slots: uses 2

Foundry notes:

  • The -1 to REF, DEX, and MOVE isn't automated, because BODY 13+ and Full Body Conversions cancel it.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > Internal Body Cyberware).
